definitions.gloss: tablespoon; large spoon used as a cooking measure
definitions.explanation: A unit of measurement in cooking equivalent to 15 milliliters. Also refers to the physical measuring spoon itself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧{大|おお}さじ⟦{一杯|いっぱい}→一杯：01793_ippai⟧。
⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{大|おお}さじ{二杯|にはい}⟦{加|くわ}えて→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please add two tablespoons of sugar.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦レシピ→レシピ：07157_reshipi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大|おお}さじ{三杯|さんばい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}います→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This recipe uses three tablespoons of miso.

notes:
A standard cooking measurement in Japan equal to 15 mL. The term is composed of {大|おお} (big) + さじ (spoon), contrasting with ⟦{小|こ}さじ→小さじ：12435_kosaji⟧ (teaspoon, 5 mL). Japanese recipes almost always specify amounts using {大|おお}さじ and ⟦{小|こ}さじ→小さじ：12435_kosaji⟧ rather than grams for liquid seasonings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}さじ⟦{一杯|いっぱい}→一杯：01793_ippai⟧: one tablespoon
- {大|おお}さじ⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧: half a tablespoon
- {大|おお}さじ⟦{山盛|やまも}り→山盛り：10157_yamamori⟧: a heaping tablespoon
- ⟦{計量|けいりょう}→計量：14797_keiryou⟧⟦スプーン→スプーン：00891_supuun⟧: measuring spoon

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{小|こ}さじ→小さじ：12435_kosaji⟧: teaspoon — 5 mL, one-third of a tablespoon
- ⟦カップ→カップ：01077_kappu⟧: cup — 200 mL in Japanese cooking (not 240 mL as in the US)
